Method of Attack: Information stealing malware that steals browser cookies and account credentials for Facebook, Gmail, and Outlook from Chromium-based browsers
Uses Node.js to run on Windows, macOS, and Linux
Disguised as a 46-51MB Windows executable appearing as PDF or Excel documents
Establishes persistence via Node.js auto-launch module and registry key
Decrypts encrypted cookies using base64-encoded decryption key from Chromium Local State file
Performs account reconnaissance abusing Facebook API using victim's IP and cookie to evade detection
Exfiltrates stolen data to attacker’s server
Impacted Systems: Chromium-based browsers (Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, Brave, Opera)
Attack Vector: Malicious executable disguised as document files delivered to victims
Stealing cookies and credentials from browser storage
Facebook API abuse for account reconnaissance
Indicators of Compromise: Domain server used by threat actors taken down on 2023-01-25
Facebook public GitHub repository containing IOCs for NodeStealer
